remarks: Surrounded by an abundance of fruit-bearing and native plants, this downtown Ojai home elicits the feeling of being hidden amid the beauty of nature while being walking distance to the shops, restaurants, farmers markets, and venues of downtown Ojai. Big, beautiful trees provide a shady canopy. Mountain views from the upstairs windows inspire contemplation and creativity.
